features.description: A configured assistant that answers routine customer enquiries using approved business information.
limitations: Accuracy depends on the quality and freshness of the approved business information.

features.description: Businesses provide approved FAQs, service descriptions, policies, and procedures so Nova can answer using that business's information.
limitations: Answers are only as accurate as the approved information provided.

features.description: Nova can be configured to collect requested service, preferred date/time, and customer contact details, then pass them through the configured booking workflow.
limitations: Booking confirmation depends on the connected booking and availability configuration. A booking is only confirmed after the connected workflow confirms it.

features.description: Businesses can organize service information so customers can ask what is offered and what each service includes.
Product-based businesses can make product information available to the assistant.
limitations: Nova does not invent product attributes, stock, or prices. Accurate prices and stock must come from current product records or connected systems.

features.description: Where current pricing and availability records are configured, Nova can use them to answer customer questions.
limitations: Nova distinguishes indicative information from confirmed prices and slots. It never invents prices.

features.description: Cart, checkout, and order-related capabilities for product-based businesses.
limitations: Payment processing, refunds, shipping providers, and payment integrations are not claimed unless confirmed. Publish only after the team verifies which functions are implemented and enabled.

features.description: Organizes customer enquiries and interactions into a lightweight customer record.
limitations: Nova does not promise a named CRM integration unless listed as supported.

features.description: An embeddable chat widget that can be added to a business website.
limitations: Device and browser compatibility must be verified before public claims.

features.description: A full-screen kiosk-style experience suitable for tablets and kiosks.
limitations: Device and browser compatibility must be verified before public claims.

features.description: Customers can chat with the business's Nova assistant on WhatsApp.
limitations: Requires an approved WhatsApp Business account and configuration.

features.description: English, Urdu, and Roman Urdu experiences are included in the project.
limitations: Exact language availability and quality depend on the current deployed configuration. Nova does not promise equal accuracy across languages or dialects.
